Yael Mizrahi  
Frontend Engineer | PixelForge Studios  
Email: yael.mizrahi@email.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/yaelmizrahi | GitHub: github.com/yaelmizrahi  

A frontend engineer with five years of experience building scalable, performance-optimized interfaces for gaming platforms. Specialized in React-based architectures, TypeScript integration, and responsive design for cross-device gameplay. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-traffic web applications that balance technical rigor with user-centric design.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Senior Frontend Engineer*  
**PixelForge Studios** (2021–Present)  
Led the development of a Next.js-powered game dashboard with real-time analytics, reducing load times by 40% through lazy loading and code splitting. Designed a TypeScript-driven framework for reusable UI components, cutting development time for new features by 30%. Spearheaded a migration from legacy CSS to a styled-components system, improving maintainability across 15+ game modules.  

Introduced Redux for state management in a multiplayer game lobby, enabling seamless synchronization of player data across 500+ concurrent users. Optimized web performance by implementing Vite for faster build times and reducing initial load latency by 25%. Mentored junior engineers on best practices for responsive design, ensuring all interfaces met accessibility standards for mobile and desktop users.  

*Frontend Engineer*  
**Midgar Interactive** (2019–2021)  
Architected a React-based tool for game asset management, streamlining the workflow for 12 artists and designers. Integrated TypeScript into existing JavaScript projects, reducing runtime errors by 60% and improving code readability. Collaborated with backend teams to implement Webpack configurations that supported dynamic imports for modular game UI components.  

*Junior Web Developer*  
**NovaGame Studios** (2018)  
Contributed to the development of a browser-based game using vanilla JavaScript and CSS3, achieving a 95/100 score on Lighthouse for performance and accessibility. Designed responsive layouts that adapted to mobile gaming devices, increasing user engagement metrics by 15% in the first quarter.  

**Projects / Side Projects**  
*PixelForge Game Dashboard* (Next.js, TypeScript, Redux)  
Built a centralized analytics hub for game developers, featuring interactive charts and real-time data visualization. Implemented server-side rendering to improve SEO and reduce bounce rates by 20%.  

*Mobile-First Game UI Toolkit* (React, Styled Components)  
Created a reusable component library for responsive game interfaces, supporting touch gestures and low-latency interactions. Integrated with Firebase for real-time player data tracking, enabling A/B testing for UI/UX improvements.  

*Performance Optimization Suite* (Webpack, Vite)  
Developed a custom Webpack plugin to bundle assets dynamically based on user device capabilities, reducing average page load time by 35% across mobile and desktop platforms.

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science  
**Tel Aviv University** (2019)

English (native), Hebrew (fluent)
